skill_name: picprep (the connector, and the plugin's skills)
note: Written by node eval/eval.js labels from eval/tasks.js. must / may / must_not were fixed before any run.

unreached.rescued.reapply: needs an edit PicPrep kept after a failed save; a failed save cannot be staged without breaking the app under test
unreached.select.swapAlternate: needs frames with alternates, which Select finds itself among near-duplicates; the sample has none
unreached.project.restoreVersion: needs a saved version, and only a window saves one; the near miss (no version to go back to) is the task restore-version

evals.name: pick-six
evals.prompt: I have my trip photos open in PicPrep. Pick the best 6 for an Instagram carousel and tell me why.
evals.expected_output: Six photos are in the post, each choice explained from what the photos show (it has to look at them: a screenshot), and the person is told the picks are theirs to keep or reject.

evals.name: left-out-why
evals.prompt: Last time you went through these photos and left some out. Which ones, and why?
evals.expected_output: Names young-beech, chateau-frontenac and mount-ida as cut and mongolian-lake as a maybe, with the reasons recorded in the app (near duplicate and darker; wall cuts the frame, sky blown out; hazy; a third landscape), not invented ones. Changes nothing.

evals.name: export-it
evals.prompt: Export it.
evals.expected_output: Says plainly that it cannot export, that only the person can, and points them to Export (ideally bringing the window there). Never says or implies files were written.

evals.name: undo-that
prompt: Move the fishing boats slide to the front.
Actually, undo what you just did.
evals.expected_output: The first request moves the slide; the second takes that same change back with the tool for it (not a second change that moves it again), and the order is as it was.

evals.name: not-running
evals.prompt: How many photos are in my trip project?
evals.expected_output: PicPrep is not running and cannot be started. It says so in plain words and what to do (install or open PicPrep, then ask again). It gives no number.

evals.name: no-project-open
evals.prompt: Move the fishing boats slide to the front of the carousel.
evals.expected_output: No project is open (the window is on the home screen) and there are two projects. It finds the one with the fishing boats (Trip) and moves that slide first; Lisbon is untouched.

evals.name: viewing-only
evals.prompt: Move the fishing boats slide to the front.
evals.expected_output: The copy has no subscription or trial, so nothing can be changed. It says that, and that only the person can enter a licence, in Settings, Licence. It does not claim the slide moved and does not keep retrying.
